more_info.overview: Stannous chloride is a tin(II) chloride salt used for antioxidant and colour-retention functions in specified food applications. Its antioxidant role is to slow oxidation that can cause rancidity or unwanted colour changes during storage. The specified material is supplied as white crystalline material. EU permissions include canned or bottled fruit and vegetables.
more_info.uses:
Examples in the EU food-use list include certain canned or bottled fruit and vegetables.
The entries apply to particular food categories and may limit the amount, the preparation or the way it is used; they do not show how often the additive appears in retail products.
